metadata.title: Meet.AI — AI meeting assistant: notes, summaries and Q&A
metadata.description: Invite AI into your meeting like a teammate: it answers by voice, takes notes, summarizes, and answers questions about the meeting.

commandPalette.placeholder: Find a meeting, an agent, or type a command…

aiModes.conversationalHint: The AI talks naturally. Best for 1:1 practice.
aiModes.on_demandHint: The AI only answers when called by name or when someone presses “Ask AI”.
aiModes.facilitatorHint: Same as above, plus periodic time and agenda checks.
aiModes.silentHint: The AI never speaks, only takes notes. Uses no AI minutes.
